evidence.evidence_text: In this work, we introduce Context-Aware MultiModal Learner (CaMML), for tuning large multimodal models (LMMs).
Based on CaMML, we have developed two multimodal models, CaMML-7B and CaMML-13B, that have shown exceptional performance across an array of benchmark datasets for multimodal tasks.
